description: This PHP source file defines the ClaimRequestModel class within the OrangeHRM Claim API model namespace. It represents a data model for claim requests, including properties like ID, reference ID, claim event details, currency information, description, and status. The class uses traits and annotations for serialization and API documentation, and it constructs its internal state based on a ClaimRequest entity.
